objects.description: [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) includes one infection vector that leverages a malicious "KeyScramblerE.DLL" library that will load during the execution of the legitimate KeyScrambler application.(Citation: Trellix Darkgate 2023)
objects.description_fa: [DarkGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1111) شامل یک ناقل عفونت است که از کتابخانه مخرب "KeyScramblerE.DLL" استفاده می کند که در طول اجرای برنامه قانونی KeyScrambler بارگیری می شود.(Citation: Trellix Darkgate 2023)
